verdict.rationale: Check documents API endpoints to create, preview, and approve payrolls, and its official MCP server lets AI agents run payroll and pull payroll details and payment diagnostics. Together these give an agent a documented way to preview a run before approval. There is no documented feature that flags anomalies in a payroll preview: the closest items are 'payment diagnostics' and a view of what's blocking payroll, which cover readiness issues rather than anomaly review, and nothing shows a preview tool exposed specifically through MCP. missing for 10: documented anomaly or variance detection on payroll previews, explicit MCP/agent preview-then-approve workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
